summary_md: **yourwifu ([@wiseadmitisfun](https://x.com/wiseadmitisfun/status/2115835317135786071))** introduces **Arguseye**, an MIT MCP server, CLI and VS Code extension that renders any React, Next.js or Vue component with real props, layouts, theme and CSS without a dev server, returning a cropped screenshot, accessibility tree and diff since last render (104 ms warm re-render) so agents can see UI breaks ([DarkWorldCoder/arguseye](https://github.com/DarkWorldCoder/arguseye), [VS Code extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=ayushniroula.arguseye), [site](https://darkworldcoder.github.io/arguseye#install)).
